scripts.check:api-dist:status: node -e "const { execFileSync } = require('node:child_process'); const out = execFileSync('git', ['status', '--porcelain', '--', 'packages/api/dist'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim(); if (out) { console.error('packages/api/dist is stale. Run npm run build:api and commit the refreshed runtime artifacts.'); console.error(out); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.check:api-dist: npm run build:api && npm run check:api-dist:status
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:hub-lite:artifacts && npm run test:api && npm run test:lsclaw:adapter:artifacts
scripts.test:core: node --test test/rules.test.mjs test/runner.test.mjs test/route-guard-analysis.test.mjs test/route-guard-analysis-shared.test.mjs test/source-structure-extractor-shared.test.mjs test/export-artifacts-shared.test.mjs test/runner-shared.test.mjs
scripts.test:lsclaw:adapter: npm run test:lsclaw:adapter:artifacts && npm run test:lsclaw:adapter:runtime
scripts.test:lsclaw:adapter:runtime: cd packages/api && npm run test -- --run tests/smoke/lsclaw-adapter.smoke.test.ts
scripts.test:api:contract: cd packages/api && npm run test -- --run tests/contract
scripts.test:api:integration: cd packages/api && npm run test -- --run tests/integration
scripts.test:api:golden: cd packages/api && npm run test -- --run tests/golden
scripts.test:api:smoke: cd packages/api && npm run test -- --run tests/smoke
scripts.quality-gate: npm run doctor && npm run build:api && npm run test && (cd packages/api && npm run typecheck) && npm run check:module-sizes
